description: AUTONOMOUS SETTLEMENT: claim YOUR receive leg of a swap using the preimage, signing with the agent's own key. This reveals the secret on-chain (so the counterparty/keeper can settle the other leg) and reports the claim to the API. Requires both legs funded and the preimage available (you are the initiator, or the initiator already revealed it). As the initiator it first checks the counterparty's escrow on chain (pays your key, agreed terms, still claimable) and refuses otherwise. Use this when the agent holds the receiving key; to claim with your own wallet use get_deal_secret, then reveal_claim. Returns the on-chain tx id.

swap_id.description: Swap id (swap.id from deal_status, or swapId once a deal is agreed)
